title.vi: Thống kê mô tả trong SQL: trung vị, phân vị, độ lệch chuẩn
title.en: Descriptive statistics in SQL: median, percentiles, standard deviation

summary.vi: AVG, trung vị bằng ROW_NUMBER, phân vị, phương sai, tương quan
summary.en: AVG, the median via ROW_NUMBER, percentiles, variance, correlation

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT amount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY amount) AS rn,
         COUNT(*)     OVER ()                 AS cnt
  FROM purchases
)
SELECT
  ROUND(AVG(amount), 2) AS mean,
  -- trung vị: giá trị giữa (hoặc trung bình hai giá trị giữa)
  (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM ranked WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2) LIMIT 1) AS median
FROM purchases;

prompt.vi: Tính TRUNG VỊ của cột amount trong purchases bằng ROW_NUMBER và COUNT() OVER (): trung bình của giá trị hoặc hai giá trị ở giữa. Trả về một cột median.
prompt.en: Compute the MEDIAN of amount in purchases with ROW_NUMBER and COUNT() OVER (): the middle value or the mean of the two middle values. Return one column median.

starter.name: query.sql
starter.code: SELECT AVG(amount) AS median FROM purchases;

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT amount,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY amount) AS rn,
         COUNT(*) OVER () AS cnt
  FROM purchases
)
SELECT AVG(amount) AS median
FROM r
WHERE rn IN ((cnt + 1) / 2, (cnt + 2) / 2);

prompt.vi: Tính độ lệch chuẩn MẪU của amount (chia n − 1) bằng công thức √[(Σx² − (Σx)²/n)/(n − 1)], làm tròn 2 chữ số, một cột sd. Dùng POWER(…, 0.5).
prompt.en: Compute the SAMPLE standard deviation of amount (divide by n − 1) with √[(Σx² − (Σx)²/n)/(n − 1)], rounded to 2 digits, one column sd. Use POWER(…, 0.5).

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
SELECT ROUND(POWER((SUM(1.0 * amount * amount) - SUM(1.0 * amount) * SUM(1.0 * amount) / COUNT(*)) / (COUNT(*) - 1), 0.5), 2) AS sd
FROM purchases;
